tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Free discovery. Returns the list of live agent-ready data packs available on DaedalMap.

tools.name: get_pack
tools.description: Free discovery. Returns detailed metadata, coverage, freshness, preferred canonical tool guidance, and first-query examples for one pack. Call this before querying a new pack so you can see time shape, coverage limits, and the paste-ready first query.

tools.name: resolve_point
tools.description: Compact reverse geocoding. Converts one WGS84 point, or a bounded point list, into the complete latest-available administrative loc_id chain through the deepest served country tier.
